/paper.bible/.note: Product name as a stylised URL. Never translate; keep the surrounding slashes.

Google.note: Company name (as in "Sign in with Google"). Never translate.

Tyndale.note: Tyndale House, the publisher of the study notes. Never translate.

PDF.note: The file format. Keep as PDF unless the locale has a standard different abbreviation.

Bible.note: Use the locale's standard word for the Christian scriptures.

design.note: A saved, editable document configuration owned by the user (the things listed under "Designs"). Keep one consistent noun across the whole UI.

version.note: An immutable rendered snapshot of a design (a built PDF). Must stay distinct from "design", and from a Bible translation.

translation.note: A Bible translation (e.g. a particular English or Spanish Bible), not the act of translating the UI.

passage.note: A selected range of Bible text, e.g. John 3:1-21.

booklet.note: A folded-and-stapled print format. Use the locale's bookbinding term.

cover.note: The wraparound book cover (front, spine and rear).

binding.note: How the printed pages are held together (perfect-bound, saddle-stitched, coil).

picture story.note: A content type: a sequence of illustrated slides retelling a Bible story.
